query: Which hyperscalers are Marvell custom AI chip customers
normalized: ai chip custom customers hyperscalers marvell which

output.content:
Marvell’s publicly identified hyperscaler custom-AI-chip customers are **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** and **Microsoft Azure**: Marvell’s work is associated with AWS’s **Trainium** accelerators and Microsoft’s **Maia** accelerators. [[1]] 

AWS is the most directly confirmed relationship in Marvell’s own disclosures: its expanded agreement with Marvell explicitly covers the supply of **custom AI products**, alongside connectivity and networking semiconductors. [[2]] 

Marvell also serves other hyperscalers with broader infrastructure silicon, but the available company disclosure does not individually identify additional customers as custom-XPU customers; therefore, Google and Meta should not be counted as publicly confirmed Marvell custom-AI-chip customers on this evidence. [[3]] [[4]]
